Best NAS for Home in 2026

For most home users, I recommend a 4-bay NAS rather than a 2-bay model. It offers more room to expand, better storage flexibility, and can serve as a central location for family photos, computer backups, movies, and personal files.

My top brands to consider are Synology, UGREEN, QNAP, and TerraMaster.

The best choice depends on whether you prioritize simplicity, performance, media streaming, or value.

Top 4 home NAS recommendations

1. UGREEN NASync DXP4800 Plus 4-Bay NAS Enclosure

Best overall hardware value
$619.99

Intel Pentium Gold 8505, 10GbE, 4 bays, NVMe slots. Excellent for Plex, Docker and fast file transfers. Software is less mature than Synology DSM.
